title: Project Grade: Interactive + Media
prompt:
GRADED PROJECT CHECKPOINT — add the interactive and media layers to your Documentation Hub: an FAQ of 3+ sibling
with non-empty summaries; a destructive-action with aria-labelledby, autofocus on the safe button and a method="dialog" form; a hero with avif + webp sources, JPEG fallback with width/height and alt; a demo

tests.name: named FAQ accordion
tests.hint: One shared name makes them an exclusive accordion; summaries carry the questions.

tests.name: safe destructive dialog
tests.hint: Named, form-closing, and focused on the safe action — the three dialog requirements.

tests.name: format-fallback hero
tests.hint: Two modern sources, one honest fallback — dimensions and alt on the only.

tests.name: sandboxed demo embed
tests.hint: Scripts only, named, lazy — the least-privilege third-party embed from the lesson.
